text: ok so uh last thing here to ask is can u tell me a path to make one of these buttons render in section D because i dont know that i have any actual current path to make that happen, which would help clarify this mess of understanding, because i believe you, they are probably there in section D, but as a user of it, i have tried basically everything to change my app state and make them show up, and i simply cant do it
resolution: Traced and documented two exact source-defined user paths for rendering the disputed Section D controls. Cleanest: on the world tab with menus/dialogs closed, focus the stage and press ]; cycle-floor runs through the live keymap, sets actionMenu=Map and increments the floor in one update, so Section D should replace Build icons with Add Chunk/Trigger/Spawn/Cycle Floor. Menu path: click Section A Map twice to open then dismiss its dropdown while retaining actionMenu=Map. File twice should similarly expose the conditional Compile icon. If the floor changes but Section D remains the Build group, the current running app has no functioning user path despite the source branch and the finding should be reclassified user-unreachable. No code changed.
